payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the woman's jacket fully closed, with no visible opening remaining along its closure?
node.criteria: Pass if the jacket's front panels meet along the entire closure and no opening remains. Fail if any visible opening remains along the closure. Unknown if the closure is obscured or the image does not provide enough evidence to determine whether it is fully closed.
node.binding: Assess the same jacket and closure as in s1. Full closure is the requested endpoint; partial closure is not complete fulfillment.

dependencies.evidence: The jacket’s front is visible in both images. In the edited image it appears open and flaring outward rather than brought together; there is no visible increase in closure compared with the source.

response.content: {"status":"fail","evidence":"The same jacket is visible in the edited image, and its front hangs open and flares outward, leaving a visible opening along the closure. It is not fully closed.","confidence":0.98,"used_dependency_ids":["s1"]}
